streams.notes: Primary session store (WAL mode). 0.20.5 schema_version=26. sessions has 56 named columns (NOT collapsed). Tables with fixture rows: sessions, messages, session_model_usage, schema_version, state_meta, system_prompts. Empty-but-present: gateway_routing, async_delegations, compression_locks, session_turn_leases, gateway_hygiene_state, plus FTS5 virtual tables. messages.tool_calls is TEXT holding a JSON array of OpenAI-style function calls (facet: tool-calls/terminal). Tool-role messages.content is TEXT holding JSON {output, exit_code, error} (facet: tool-result/terminal). CLI-only farm does not populate gateway tables. WAL/SHM siblings are absent after a clean close. Schema dump: sources/<version>.sqlite-schema.sql.

Session store of a NAMED profile: every state.db belongs to exactly one profile — <root>/state.db to `default`, <root>/profiles/<name>/state.db to <name> (0.21.4 hermes_state_profile_repair.py:1-21; hermes_constants.py:228-262 recognises <root>/profiles/<name> as a profile home; profile names are lowercase path components, hermes_cli/profiles.py:240). Same schema and writer as state-db (hermes_state_usage.py:52-71), so the adapter drives it with the same snapshot plan. Session ids are unique across stores by construction: `<YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS>_<uuid4 hex>` (hermes_state_ids.py:24-28), and `hermes sessions repair-profiles` moves a crossed row between stores under the same id. `hermes profile create --clone-all` never copies state.db (hermes_cli/profiles.py:60-67). Tombstones live one level deeper (profiles/.deleted/<name>/state.db) and are not matched. Research evidence from the pinned 0.21.4 source; native capture pending (the 0.20.5 CLI farm runs the default profile only).
Non-secret settings. Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint lives at model.provider=custom + model.base_url + model.api_key. Docker first-boot may migrate missing keys.
Primary agent identity injected into the system prompt. Seeded on first run even with --ignore-rules.
API keys and secrets — MUST-NOT-PARSE; inventory only, excluded from harvest.
OAuth provider credentials (Nous Portal, Codex, …) — MUST-NOT-PARSE; excluded from harvest.
Persistent memory documents (MEMORY.md, USER.md).
Bundled + agent-created skills. Vendor bundles are stripped at harvest.
Scheduled job definitions.
Legacy per-session JSONL. Dead: CLI/gateway resume from state.db. Still inventoried so an unexpected revival is UnknownFile-adjacent rather than silent.
Runtime logs (errors.log, gateway.log, agent.log). Stripped at harvest.
Per-terminal -c breadcrumbs keyed by tty/tmux/kitty pane.
Event hooks.
Per-profile HOME for tool subprocesses when terminal.home_mode=profile. Stripped at harvest.
Updater stamp written on first run. Volatile; stripped at harvest.

Every other file of a named profile's HOME (0.21.4 hermes_constants.py:281 identity markers: config.yaml, .env, SOUL.md, profile.yaml, auth.json): the per-profile config, persona, memories, skills, cron, logs, and credentials (.env, auth.json — MUST-NOT-PARSE, exactly like the root streams). Inventory only; no driver. Listed after profile-state-db so the session store keeps its own stream.
